en.description:
HOW TO INSTALL ON APPLE WATCH
Please download Block Cheer! from the App Store on your Apple Watch.

1. Press the Digital Crown to open the app list.
2. Find and open the App Store on your watch.
3. Scroll to the bottom and tap Account.
4. Tap Purchased, find Block Cheer!, and tap the download button.

BLOCK CHEER! — THREE GAMES FOR APPLE WATCH
Enjoy Fit & Clear, Falling Blocks and Sand Blast with Block Cheer! right on your wrist. Play offline, choose your favorite mode, and challenge your best score whenever you have a few minutes to spare.

FIT & CLEAR — DRAG, PLACE & CLEAR
Drag different block shapes onto the board. Fill a complete row or column to clear space and earn points. Plan each placement carefully: the game ends when none of the available blocks can fit.

FALLING BLOCKS — MOVE, ROTATE & DROP
Arrange falling pieces to complete horizontal lines. Swipe left or right to move, tap to rotate, and swipe down to drop a piece into place. Keep clearing lines as the falling speed increases.

SAND BLAST
Move and rotate each falling piece. When it lands, it breaks into sand. Connect sand of the same color across the board to clear it and score.

BUILT FOR YOUR WRIST
• Three block games in one Apple Watch app.
• Offline gameplay — no internet connection needed to play.
• Simple touch controls for each game.
• Pause, continue, restart, or return to game selection.
• Resume your saved Falling Blocks game.
• Separate best scores for all three games.
• Adjustable sound and haptic feedback.

Whether you enjoy planning each move or reacting to falling pieces, choose your challenge and make every block count.

Questions or suggestions?
Contact us at support@gameboxwatch.com.

Privacy Policy: https://gameboxwatch.com/block-puzzle/privacy/
Terms of Service: https://gameboxwatch.com/block-puzzle/terms/
en.releaseNotes: Play Sand Blast, a new falling-sand puzzle for Apple Watch. Each game now has its own light color palette, with shared pause controls and a results screen showing your score and personal best.
en.subtitle: Offline Games: Stack & Clear

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
Important Note: This app can only be downloaded from the App Store on Apple Watch. Here's how:
1. Press the Digital Crown on your watch to open the app list
2. Find and open the App Store
3. Scroll to the bottom and tap [Account]
4. Find [Purchased] to download the app

This app has been updated by Apple to prepare for watchOS 27 compatibility. No new features are included.

- Optimize user experience.

- A new dark neon look for Fit & Clear.
- Refreshed tiles, placement previews and pause styling.
- Send feedback from Settings > Contact Us.
Play Sand Blast, a new falling-sand puzzle for Apple Watch. Each game now has its own light color palette, with shared pause controls and a results screen showing your score and personal best.
